svg.title: Granite 3 8B FP16 versus scaled FP8 throughput
svg.desc: Four panels show effective TFLOP per second over M for all unique single-device Granite linear projection shapes. Each panel has its own vertical scale.
svg.text: Granite 3 8B TP1 linear projections: FP16 vs scaled FP8
Mean Kineto device-kernel time; 5 warmups and 20 measured iterations; each panel uses its own y-axis scale
